enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto right side. Remains asleep. Moves arm under pillow. Turns onto back. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep. Shifts legs. Pulls blanket. Turns onto left side. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene routine, including showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Takes off pajamas. Steps into shower. Turns on shower water. Washes body with soap. Shampoos hair. Rinses off. Turns off shower water. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off bathroom light.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bread. Closes cupboard. Places frying pan on stove. Turns on stove. Melts butter in pan. Cracks eggs into pan. Fries eggs. Toasts bread. Places eggs on plate. Places toast on plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt. Selects pants. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Stands in front of mirror. Adjusts shirt. Brushes hair. Picks up work bag. Checks contents of bag. Picks up keys. Picks up phone. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Enters hospital. Walks to locker room. Changes into work uniform. Walks to therapy area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, treating patients and conducting therapy sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Greets patient in waiting area. Escorts patient to treatment room. Asks patient about pain level. Reviews patient's medical chart. Instructs patient to sit on treatment table. Palpates patient's affected area. Demonstrates exercises. Guides patient through exercises. Applies manual therapy techniques. Adjusts patient's posture. Attaches electrodes for electrical stimulation. Turns on stimulation device. Monitors patient's response. Turns off device. Removes electrodes. Provides instructions for home exercises. Documents treatment in computer. Walks patient to reception. Schedules next appointment. Calls next patient.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food items. Places food on tray. Pays at cashier. Takes receipt. Finds empty table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Checks phone. Talks with colleague. Finishes meal. Places tray on conveyor belt. Walks out of cafeteria. Walks to break room. Sits on chair. Closes eyes briefly. Stands up. Walks back to therapy area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, continuing patient care and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Greets next patient. Reviews patient's progress notes. Conducts therapy session. Adjusts equipment. Demonstrates exercises. Monitors patient's technique. Corrects patient's form. Applies ice pack to patient's knee. Wraps bandage around patient's ankle. Records treatment details in computer. Updates patient's chart. Answers phone call from doctor. Discusses patient's case with colleague. Prepares treatment room for next patient. Cleans therapy equipment. Washes hands. Greets next patient. Escorts patient to treatment room. Conducts initial assessment. Develops treatment plan.

Walks out of hospital. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to home. Unlocks door. Enters home. Takes off shoes. Puts down bag. Hangs up coat.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil to pan. Adds meat to pan. Stirs meat. Adds vegetables. Cooks stir-fry. Cooks rice in rice cooker. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up.

Fills sink with water. Adds dish soap. Picks up sponge. Scrubs dishes. Rinses dishes under running water. Places dishes in drying rack. Dries hands with towel. Wipes counter with cloth. Wipes stove. Sweeps floor. Empties trash. Takes trash to bin outside. Returns to kitchen. Turns off kitchen light. Walks to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote control. Turns on TV. Turns on air conditioner. Adjusts air conditioner temperature. Changes TV channel. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Eats snack. Watches TV. Changes TV channel. Turns off TV. Turns off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal tasks or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enters study. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Sits on chair. Logs into computer. Opens web browser. Checks email. Reads news. Opens document. Types on keyboard. Uses mouse. Reads book. Turns pages. Closes book. Shuts down computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks out of study.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Uses toilet. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Turns off water heater. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, using phone or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through social media. Watches video. Puts down phone. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Closes book. Puts down book. Turns off bedroom light. Lies in bed. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto right side. Remains asleep. Moves arm under pillow. Turns onto back. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep. Shifts legs. Pulls blanket. Turns onto left side. Remains asleep.
